cases.name: apple-container-root
cases.why: An apple-container cage reads ~/.config/agentcage/apple-container/<name>/logs/, not the data root.

cases.name: apple-container-root-missing
cases.why: The path named in the error is the apple root, not the data root.

error: no capture file found for cage 'mac-agent'

  Add this to your cage.yaml and run `agentcage cage update`:
    capture:
      enable_har: true

cases.name: filter-host-substring

cases.name: filter-direction-empty

cases.name: filter-since-iso-keeps-all
cases.why: An ISO --since before both timestamps.

cases.name: filter-since-iso-keeps-none
cases.why: An ISO --since after both.

cases.name: max-entries-keeps-last
cases.why: -n keeps the LAST n, not the first.

cases.name: max-entries-zero-unlimited
cases.why: 0 is the documented 'unlimited', not 'none'.

cases.name: capture-disabled
cases.why: `capture: enable_har: false` and 'the file is not there yet' are the same error — there is no state that distinguishes them.
cases.stderr:
error: no capture file found for cage 'plain-cage'
  Expected: {HOME}/.local/share/agentcage/plain-cage/capture/capture.jsonl

  Add this to your cage.yaml and run `agentcage cage update`:
    capture:
      enable_har: true

cases.name: legacy-v021-cage
cases.why: The v0.22 gate, which exits 2 rather than 1.
cases.stderr:
error: cage 'plain-cage' was created with agentcage v0.21.3, which used the
  legacy 3-service layout (cage / proxy / dns). v0.22 unified these into a
  single 'egress' service. The cage cannot be addressed by v0.22 commands.

  To migrate, run:
    systemctl --user stop plain-cage-cage plain-cage-proxy plain-cage-dns
    agentcage cage destroy plain-cage
    agentcage cage create -c <your cage.yaml>

cases.name: no-metadata-reads-as-legacy
cases.why: A missing metadata.json defaults to v0.0.0 and trips the same gate.
